calls.reason: The Fed paper says the labs are not consistently profitable, and the IMF notes growing reliance on outside financing. But the IMF also says profitable incumbents anchor the boom, and no industry-wide accounts were found.
This is a rhetorical causal claim tested on only five days after Huang left. TechCrunch interviewees doubt the boom ends without him, but those are expectations, not observed outcomes.

Ramp's 80%/1% figure covers business spending in its own data, not total revenue. Cursor confirms NVIDIA funding, but nothing shows the top customers are mostly unprofitable startups or ranks purchasers.
Yahoo Finance reports NVIDIA was tightening support, but its signed deals remain owed and the Anthropic investment proceeds. No evidence measures remaining industry support against funding needs.
